name_zh: 杜瓦利埃/海地/医生/独裁/通顿/伏都/贫困/弗朗索瓦/通顿/马库特
description_zh: 弗朗索瓦·杜瓦利埃 (1957-1971) 海地总统 (1957-1971) 医生出身的独裁者，通过伏都教和恐怖统治掌权，被誉为 "通顿独裁者", 对拉美政治和毒品贸易产生深远影响。
description_en: François Duvalier (1957-1971) Haitian President (1957-1971) doctor-turned-dictator, through voodoo and terror rule gained power, known as "Papa Doc Dictator", had profound impact on Latin American politics and drug trade.
reason_zh: 杜瓦利埃代表拉美独裁者如何通过宗教和恐怖统治掌权，如何建立个人独裁政权，以及如何成为拉美政治和毒品贸易的象征，体现了拉美政治的复杂性。
reason_en: Duvalier represents how Latin American dictators achieve power through religion and terror rule, establish personal dictatorship, and become symbol of Latin American politics and drug trade, embodies complexity of Latin American politics.
